name: Drupal Atomic Builder
description: Build, preview and scaffold Single Directory Components (SDC) from the Drupal admin following the Atomic Design pattern.
project_description: Drupal Atomic Builder (DAB) gives front-end developers an in-admin workbench for Single Directory Components (SDC). It lists every SDC discovered across core, contrib and custom modules and themes, groups them by Atomic Design type (atoms, molecules, organisms, templates, pages) and renders each one in a live, responsive iframe preview driven by the component's own prop and slot examples. From the same UI developers can scaffold new components (generating the .component.yml, Twig, README and optional JS/CSS files) and edit, duplicate or delete the components they own, without hand-creating content or files. Create/edit/delete operations are restricted to custom modules and themes so core and contrib components stay read-only. The module ships a Markdown-rendered documentation tab (league/commonmark), a cache/asset-reload button, and toolbar/navigation integration. It is a developer aid and its maintainers strongly advise against enabling it in production environments.
